description: The absence-CHECK form `@x is not` does not fire E-TYPE-045 (§42.10). `if (@ready is not)` is the canonical postfix absence check, not a prefix negation, so E-TYPE-045 stays silent. The clean twin of e-type-045-prefix-not-negation-pos.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 1 (g-boot-body-top-lift-render-s478, option (b)) — migrated: a body-top `${ … }` renders nothing (§17.3 amended S478)
rationale: §42.10 `expr is not` is the sanctioned absence check; E-TYPE-045 fires only on the forbidden PREFIX `not expr` negation form. (S478 open-Qs ruling item 1: migrated from a body-top `${ if (…) { <p/> } }`, which renders nothing there and is E-MARKUP-STATEMENT-NOT-RENDERED (§17.3 amended S478), to the `if=` attribute form.)
